children: Allarity Therapeutics announced JPO grant of a key patent for its stenoparib-specific DRP® companion diagnostic, providing protection in Japan into 2039.
Japan Patent No. 7917283 granted for stenoparib-specific DRP® methods, protecting use in Japan through 2039.
Patent covers DRP methods to predict clinical benefit and select patients likely to respond to stenoparib.
Further strengthens Allarity’s IP estate alongside U.S. protection extending into April 2042 and patents in Europe and Australia.
Company says patent supports development and potential commercialization of stenoparib with its DRP® companion diagnostic in Japan.

title: Allarity Therapeutics wins Japanese patent for stenoparib DRP® diagnostic, protection into 2039
